notes: YEAR-ONLY style: the year rule is stated in retrievable text, but the month rule is chart-image-only and is HELD, not guessed. Page states the year comes from the combined 2nd and 3rd characters (the page highlights the example as A04 07142, grouping the letter with digits 04) and the month comes from the 1st letter via a chart shown only as an image (Aqua-Star_Benjamin-Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png), which text fetch cannot read. The month letter table is therefore not encoded here; it is an image-pass item. The page lists Benjamin as a related brand and the chart filename pairs Aqua Star with Benjamin, but the chart itself was not read, so no shared-system sister claim is made. No era dates are documented on the page; the era below describes serial shape only.
